data_objects.name: daily_bike_share_activity
data_objects.meaning: Daily bike-share system activity records containing daily and cumulative trips and mileage, annual membership totals and sign-ups, and short-duration pass purchases.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the bike-share activity record.

variables.name: Trips over the past 24-hours (midnight to 11:59pm)
variables.meaning: Number of bike-share trips during the stated calendar day.

variables.name: Cumulative trips (since launch):
variables.meaning: Cumulative number of bike-share trips since system launch through the date.

variables.name: Miles traveled today (midnight to 11:59 pm)
variables.meaning: Distance traveled during the stated calendar day.

variables.name: Miles traveled to date:
variables.meaning: Cumulative distance traveled through the date.

variables.name: Total Annual Memberships Sold
variables.meaning: Cumulative or current total of annual memberships sold as recorded on the date; the reset convention is not stated.

variables.name: Annual Member Sign-Ups (midnight to 11:59 pm)
variables.meaning: Number of annual-member sign-ups during the stated calendar day.

variables.name: 24-Hour Passes Purchased (midnight to 11:59 pm)
variables.meaning: Number of 24-hour passes purchased during the stated calendar day.

variables.name: 7-Day Passes Purchased (midnight to 11:59 pm)
variables.meaning: Number of 7-day passes purchased during the stated calendar day.

structure.description: Each row represents one calendar day of bike-share system activity, with Date providing the temporal key.
Daily trip, distance, sign-up, and pass-purchase measures coexist with since-launch trip and mileage totals and an annual-membership total.

uncertainties: The bike-share system, launch date, timezone, and interpretation or reset convention for Total Annual Memberships Sold are not specified.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels, date format, and units explicitly visible in train.csv.
